comment: The SVG is parsed by nanosvg and each shape's paths are resampled into a 2048-point table by arc length (Trace.cpp:185 to :196). Normalisation divides by the larger of the two bounding-box dimensions and multiplies by 10, and the y axis is negated so that an SVG's downward y becomes an upward voltage (Trace.cpp:210 to :223). A paste is accepted only if the clipboard text contains <svg or <path (Trace.cpp:323). The module has no early return when nothing is patched, so it traces whether or not the outputs are read. The panel prints LISSAJOUS where the slug is Trace.
